title: Daq capabilities
description: A two-weight uppercase heading over a row of large square-cornered service cards (number, monospace tech tags, a big title, a short line, an 'explore' link and a huge hairline-thin index numeral). On desktop the section pins for four windows of scroll while the card row slides left, a progress line fills under it, the current tab lights and each card's title fills with white from left to right as it arrives. On phones the cards stack and each title fills as its card scrolls in.
notes: all motion is CSS scroll-driven (no JavaScript); without support the cards sit in a row you can't slide on desktop, so keep to five or fewer there
430% of the window tall from 1024px (the pinned track); content-sized on phones
